title: Vortex Model of Elementary Particles
content: This paper proposes a unified picture of elementary particles based on one medium, the Dynamic Quantum Vacuum, called DQV. A particle is not a point moving in empty vacuum. A particle is a vortex of DQV itself. The proton is a stable vortex that can exist at rest. The electron is a vortex of a different kind. It has no rest form. It moves always, by spin, by trembling, and by orbit. The photon is not a particle in the same sense. It is a brief excitation travelling through DQV. Mass is energy stored in the vortex. Charge is winding of phase around the vortex. Gravity is depletion of DQV density. Electromagnetism is phase, static as electricity, circulating as magnetism, waving as light. Strong force is vortices locked together when cores overlap. Weak force is vortices re-winding. Matter does not move in vacuum. Matter is motion of the vacuum itself.
